label: Sign-in code
subject: Your sign-in code for Recordly
heading: Sign in to
message: Enter this code into Recordly. Don't share this with anyone.
preheader: Your sign-in code is inside. See you in Recordly.

label: Verify email / sign up
subject: Your verification code for Recordly
heading: Verify your email for
message: Enter this code into Recordly to verify your email. Don't share this with anyone.
preheader: One small step and you're ready to record.

label: Account invitation
subject: You're invited to Recordly
heading: You're invited to
message: Your invitation's here. Set up your account and come make something with Recordly.
preheader: You're invited. Come make something worth sharing.

label: Confirm new email
subject: Confirm your new email for Recordly
heading: Update your email for
message: Confirm {{ .NewEmail }} as the new email address for your Recordly account.
preheader: Confirm your new email to keep everything in sync.

label: Password reset
subject: Reset your Recordly password
heading: Reset your password for
message: Fresh start? Choose a new password for your Recordly account using the link below.
preheader: A fresh password is just a click away.

label: Confirm sensitive action
subject: Confirm it's you on Recordly
heading: Verify it's you for
message: Enter this code in Recordly to confirm this action. Don't share this with anyone.
preheader: Your code to confirm this action is inside.

label: Password changed
subject: Your Recordly password was changed
heading: Password changed for
message: Your Recordly password was changed. If this was you, you're all set.
detail: If you didn't make this change, sign in with an email code, change your password and contact support.
preheader: A quick heads-up about your account security.

label: Email address changed
subject: Your Recordly email address was changed
heading: Email updated for
message: Your Recordly account email changed from {{ .OldEmail }} to {{ .Email }}.
detail: If you didn't make this change, contact support immediately.
preheader: Your account email was updated. Please check this was you.

label: Phone number changed
subject: Your Recordly phone number was changed
heading: Phone updated for
message: Your Recordly account phone number changed from {{ .OldPhone }} to {{ .Phone }}.
detail: If you didn't make this change, contact support immediately.
preheader: Your account phone number was updated. Please check this was you.

label: Sign-in method linked
subject: A sign-in method was added to Recordly
heading: Sign-in method added to
message: {{ .Provider }} was linked to your Recordly account.
detail: If you didn't make this change, contact support immediately.
preheader: A sign-in method was added. Please check this was you.

label: Sign-in method removed
subject: A sign-in method was removed from Recordly
heading: Sign-in method removed from
message: {{ .Provider }} was removed from your Recordly account.
detail: If you didn't make this change, contact support immediately.
preheader: A sign-in method was removed. Please check this was you.

label: MFA method added
subject: A verification method was added to Recordly
heading: Verification added to
message: A verification method ({{ .FactorType }}) was added to your Recordly account.
detail: If you didn't make this change, contact support immediately.
preheader: A verification method was added. Please check this was you.

label: MFA method removed
subject: A verification method was removed from Recordly
heading: Verification removed from
message: A verification method ({{ .FactorType }}) was removed from your Recordly account.
detail: If you didn't make this change, contact support immediately.
preheader: A verification method was removed. Please check this was you.
